text: With EmberStake.sol live on Base Sepolia, Desmond Okoro and Julian Hargrove run a full dress rehearsal with real test wallets.
Five funded wallets stake, wait through real blocks while rewards accrue, call claimRewards(), and two of them withdraw their stake.
Every step comes back clean -- correct payouts, clean withdrawals, and the indexer matching on-chain state exactly.
Vivian Castellan signs off on the real user journey -- but every wallet used today is a normal wallet, nothing adversarial.
Next: the final mainnet-readiness checklist, and kicking off the dedicated security audit.
